citationText: The account of the poor performance of the Farnsworth “electron camera” came from Tony Bridgewater, the noted British television historian. He worked with John Baird from 1929 to 1932 and then was with the BBC from 1932 until his retirement. He was present at the opening of the London Television Service in November 1936.
